description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、アセンブルの幅が広がる特徴的な特殊タンクを装備した機体が登場。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," an aircraft equipped with a distinctive special tank that expands the range of assembly has appeared.

description.ja: ■頭部、コア、腕部、脚部それぞれにシリーズ共通構造を採用し、ゲーム内同様に「アセンブル」をプラモデルで楽しめる。
description.en: • The head, core, arms, and legs each use the same structure as the series, allowing you to enjoy "assembling" the plastic model just like in the game.

description.ja: ■「VE-66LRB」は別売りの「30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 06」に付属する「ウェポンハンガー」に懸架可能。
description.en: • "VE-66LRB " can be suspended on the " Weapon hanger " included in the " 30MM optional parts set ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 06" sold separately.

description.ja: ■別売りの「アクションベース8」に対応。
